0.body:
Settings can be configured in the following ways, in order of priority: Command line flag Environment variables Configuration file Default value The location of the configuration file can be specified using --config or the environment variable SYND_CONFIG_FILE. By default, synd searches the following locations depending on the platform: Platform Locations Linux $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/syndicationd/config.toml$HOME/.config/syndicationd/config.toml macOS $HOME/Library/Application Support/syndicationd/config.toml Windows {FOLDERID_RoamingAppData}/syndicationd/config.toml synd does not automatically create configuration files. To create one, run: synd config init > config.toml To inspect the resolved configuration after flags, environment variables, configuration files, and defaults have been applied, use config view. synd config view
synd config view -o json
0.title: Configuration

1.body: Flag Environment variable Configuration file Default Description --config SYND_CONFIG_FILE - see above Configuration file path --log SYND_LOG_FILE [log.path] see synd config view Log file path --cache-dir SYND_CACHE_DIR [cache.directory] see synd config view Cache directory --theme SYND_THEME [theme.name] ferra Theme name --sqlite-db SYND_SQLITE_DB [backend.sqlite_db] see synd config view SQLite database path --entries-limit SYND_ENTRIES_LIMIT [feed.entries_limit] 200 Feed entries to fetch --browser SYND_BROWSER [feed.browser.command] - Command to browse feed --browser-args SYND_BROWSER_ARGS [feed.browser.args] [] Command args to browse feed - - [keys.<layer>.keymap] built-in keymap Custom key bindings

10.body: Use [keys.list] for movement in both tabs. For a movement key specific to one tab, use the same list command in [keys.entries] or [keys.feeds]. These layers also accept tab-specific names such as entries.next and feeds.first. Layer Action Default key Command list Move to the next item j or down list.next list Move to the previous item k or up list.prev list Jump to the first item g g list.first list Jump to the last item g e list.last entries Read the article in the built-in reader space entries.read entries Open the article in your web browser enter entries.open entries Open the article in your configured text browser Unbound entries.browse entries Refresh the timeline r timeline.refresh feeds Add a subscription a feeds.subscribe feeds Edit the selected subscription e feeds.edit feeds Open the unsubscribe dialog d feeds.unsubscribe feeds Open the feed's website in your web browser enter feeds.open feeds Reload the subscription list r feeds.reload In Feeds, press a to subscribe or e to edit the selected subscription. Use Tab and Shift-Tab to move between fields. A new subscription defaults to polling every 24h. Editing opens the saved poll interval and labels, including category. Choose Remove beside a label to delete it and Save to apply the changes. Press Esc to cancel.

12.body: Action Default key Command in [keys.filter] Search by keyword / filter.search Choose categories c filter.category Select the previous feed priority h or left filter.requirement.prev Select the next feed priority l or right filter.requirement.next Leave search or category selection esc filter.close synd assigns the keys for search-prompt and category-filter. While searching, use Backspace to delete the previous character. While choosing categories, press the shortcut beside a category to toggle it, + to select all categories, or - to clear the selection.

15.body: What to follow How to get the feed Example GitHub releases Append /releases.atom to the repository URL. Syndicationd releases Git tags on GitHub Append /tags.atom to the repository URL. Syndicationd tags Versions of a Rust crate Use https://static.crates.io/rss/crates/<crate>.xml. synd releases Events in a connpass group Append /ja.atom to the group URL. OpenTelemetry events Posts on a Hatena Blog Append /feed to the blog URL. Hatena Blog staff The crates.io feed announcement also lists registry-wide feeds for new crates and new versions .
15.title: Feed tips

16.body: For a blog without its own feed, look it up in Olshansk/rss-feeds . Copy the URL from the Feed column into your reader, for example the Anthropic Engineering feed . To look up a page on Open RSS , insert openrss.org/ after https:// in its URL and open that address in your browser. If a feed is available, copy the subscription URL from the preview. For example, the r/HelixEditor preview links to an Atom feed for hot posts . Reddit retired its native .rss feeds in November 2026 .

2.body: The theme can be changed with --theme, SYND_THEME, or [theme.name]. Run synd --help to see the available values. Under [theme], set background = "transparent" to use your terminal's background and opacity. The default is "theme".

3.body: The default log file path is based on ProjectDirs::data_dir(). Use synd config view to inspect the resolved output destination. The log directives can be changed with the SYND_LOG environment variable. SYND_LOG=synd=debug synd

7.body: A key binding assigns a command to a key or a sequence of keys. A layer is a group of bindings. In the Entries tab, j moves to the next item using the list layer, and Space opens the reader using the entries layer. Screen or prompt Active layers, highest priority first Entries tab filter → entries → list → tabs → global → app Feeds tab filter → feeds → list → tabs → global → app Typing a search search-prompt just before filter in the current tab Choosing categories category-filter just before filter in the current tab Article reader reader → global → app Subscribe or edit subscribe → text-input → app Unsubscribe confirmation unsubscribe-popup → app Login screen login → global → app When two layers handle the same key, the one on the left takes priority. In the Entries list, q quits (global). In the article reader, q closes the article (reader).
